failures.stage: Saving build identity after the dev suite had invalidated it
failures.handling: Retained failed traces; production was rebuilt and identity validation moved before Electron launch.

interpretation: No newly requested resources in the measured baseline popup openings; layout and JS time do not explain the largest observed pause.
GPU traces show additional drawing/submission work. Full-screen backdrop filtering is a removable shared rendering cost, not a proven explanation for every first-open pause.
No-blur controls first-contact maxima were consistently about 19-21ms; ordinary-round-corner controls still had large pauses.
Restoring original styles also produced fast runs: graphics/process caches and local scheduling affect results, so do not claim a deterministic cold-start percentage improvement.
limits: Isolated fixed 4-agent/two-conversation profile; model calls 0, no personal database.
Production 9 fresh sessions per side; dev only 3 per side. No P95, physical FPS or every-device guarantee.

maxFrame includes initial click/mount work. animationMaxFrame selects rAF intervals starting within the 250ms CSS transition, allowing 1ms event/rAF ordering skew; long intervals extending past transition end remain included. Both are reported.
firstPaint means popup DOM found during rAF, not external display latency.
The 667ms first smoke observation remains recorded, but is not used as the entire baseline.
Blur removal visibly keeps the background sharper. Original overlay tint, dialog scale/fade durations and modal semantics are preserved.
AlertDialog receives the same overlay change and semantic regressions, without separate cold-frame certification.
